title: ConfirmShipmentRequest
description: The request schema for an shipment confirmation.

codCollectionMethod.description: The COD collection method (only supported in the JP marketplace).

carrierCode.description: Identifies the carrier that will deliver the package. This field is required for all marketplaces. For more information, refer to the [`CarrierCode` announcement](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/changelog/carriercode-value-required-in-shipment-confirmations-for-br-mx-ca-sg-au-in-jp-marketplaces).

carrierName.description: Carrier name that will deliver the package. Required when `carrierCode` is "Other"

shippingMethod.description: Ship method to be used for shipping the order.

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number used to obtain tracking and delivery information.

shipDate.description: The shipping date for the package. Must be in ISO 8601 date/time format.

shipFromSupplySourceId.description: The unique identifier for the supply source.

orderItems.description: The list of order items and quantities to be updated.

PackageReferenceId.description: A seller-supplied identifier that uniquely identifies a package within the scope of an order. Only positive numeric values are supported.

TransparencyCode.description: The transparency code associated with the item.
